summary: Zidovudine carries the United States Food and Drug Administration's strongest boxed warning for blood-related harm (hematologic toxicity), metabolic issues, and liver injury [3][5]. Its official warnings also include severe liver failure (hepatic decompensation) when used alongside certain hepatitis treatments, as well as muscle damage (myopathy) and severe liver enlargement with fat accumulation [5]. In addition, a small computer model, not tests on people, calculated a high score for liver problems and a low score for heart problems [M].
